Summarize Core Methylation Array QC Metrics

Source: R/module_utilities.R
Meth_QC.Rd

Creates a deterministic QC bundle from matched metadata/beta inputs and optional detection p-values or a minfi object. The returned list is designed Not intended for direct storage in ImprintomeSet (QC data is handled by MethQcSet).

Usage

Meth_QC(
  betaFile,
  metaFile = NULL,
  detection_p = NULL,
  minfi_object = NULL,
  assay = NULL,
  p_cutoff = 0.05,
  mean_detection_cutoff = 0.03,
  intensity_cutoff = 11
)

Arguments

betaFile

Beta matrix/data.frame, file path, or an ImprintomeSet.

metaFile

Optional metadata data.frame or file path. Not required when betaFile is an ImprintomeSet.

detection_p

Optional detection p-value matrix/data.frame with samples in columns.

minfi_object

Optional minfi object used to derive methylated and unmethylated intensity medians.

assay

Optional assay label. When omitted and betaFile is an ImprintomeSet, assay(betaFile) is used.

p_cutoff

Detection p-value threshold used for per-sample recall.

mean_detection_cutoff

Mean detection p-value threshold for PASS/FAIL.

intensity_cutoff

Minimum average median intensity for PASS/FAIL.

Value

Named list containing metadata_qc, beta_qc, optional detection_qc, optional detection_recall_rate, optional intensity_qc, and merged sample_qc.
